payload.text: v0.1.7 one-command release validation for pplr-vc (hv gave pplr-vc the pen on ccusage, 2026-11-04): review dc's commit (bin/devbin post-cut as the one after:, finalize notarising always with geodica.apple.*, no CCUSAGE_NOTARY_PROFILE), then in a fresh clone at its hash: check all, test all, build and doctor measured in a slot from pplr-vc's desk, release v0.1.7 --dry-run ending at the confirm step, and a read-only notarytool history probe through finalize's own reader. Pre-hash list sent to pplr-vc; review points sent to dc. No pushes, tags, releases or tap writes: hv runs the cut.
